run_GTestColorTest: run the GTestColorTest suite to verify Google Test color detection logic
test_SetEnvVar: test the SetEnvVar function to set or unset environment variables by name
test_UsesColor: test the UsesColor function to check if gtest outputs color for a given TERM and flag
test_GTestColorTest_testNoEnvVarNoFlag: test color auto-detection behavior when neither GTEST_COLOR env var nor gtest_color flag is set
test_GTestColorTest_testAliasesOfYesAndN: test that yes/no aliases like true false 1 0 are accepted for the gtest_color flag
